Travel Tips

Practical advice to make your China family journey smooth and enjoyable.

📋

Before You Go

  • Apply for a China visa in advance
  • Download translation apps (Baidu Translate)
  • Set up mobile payment (Alipay / WeChat)
  • Pack a small first-aid kit
🌞

Weather & Clothing

  • Dress according to the season
  • Wear comfortable shoes for the Great Wall
  • Bring sun protection in summer
  • Carry a compact umbrella
🍴

Dining Advice

  • Book Peking Duck restaurants in advance
  • Choose reputable restaurants
  • Inform staff of any food allergies
  • Try local street food specialties
👪

Family Travel

  • Bring entertainment for children
  • Schedule regular rest breaks
  • Carry water and small snacks
  • Keep hotel address cards handy
